# Luminix — Autonomous AI Health & Biomechanical Intelligence Platform

> Private, client-side, zero-lag health ecosystem fusing 60 FPS computer vision kinematics, adaptive strength training, yoga posture guidance, and metabolic intelligence into a Kyoto cyber aesthetic.

## System Overview
- **Name**: Luminix
- **Domain**: AI Health, Physical Biomechanics, Computer Vision, Functional Longevity
- **Author & Creator**: Ram Charan Teja (@LUNO895)
- **Contact**: ramcharantejak396@gmail.com
- **Repository**: https://github.com/LUNO895
- **Architecture**: Client-side MediaPipe WebAssembly (kinematics/angles) + Asynchronous FastAPI (Python 3.11) + Three.js WebGL (procedural sanctuary environment) + Google Gemini multi-model intelligence fallback.

## Core Disciplines & Modules
- **60 FPS Live Pose Engine (`/live-pose`)**: 33-point Landmark Kinematics calculating real-time joint angular geometry (`calculateAngle`), knee valgus, lumbar hyperextension, and postural risk factors directly in-browser. Zero camera streaming to third-party servers.
- **Adaptive Gym Engine (`/gym`)**: Biomechanical discrete state machines (`idle` -> `descending` -> `inflection` -> `ascending` -> `completed`) tracking concentric and eccentric tempo for squats, deadlifts, push-ups, pull-ups, bench press, and bicep curls.
- **17 Sacred Yoga Asanas (`/yoga`)**: Real-time angle bounds validation, balance scoring, and hold duration counters across beginner, intermediate, and master asanas.
- **Metabolic Matrix & Nutrition (`/bmi`)**: Clinical Mifflin-St Jeor and Harris-Benedict formulas for BMR/TDEE calculation and macronutrient partitioning.
- **Food & Hydration Intelligence (`/food-tracker`)**: Macro logging, hydration goals, and AI food analysis.
- **Luna AI Assistant (`/luna`)**: Conversational wellness intelligence grounded in user kinematics and metabolic history with clinical guardrails.
- **Clinical Export Studio (`/export`)**: Multi-format health dossiers, automated PDF generation, and explainer video briefings.

## Privacy & Security Manifesto
- **Client-Side Privacy**: Biometric camera frames are processed locally inside the browser memory via WebAssembly; no raw video streams leave the user's device.
- **Application Security Firewall**: Built-in WAF middleware with token bucket rate limiting and strict CORS protection.
